acceptanceCriteria: Resolved as the finding's Fix describes, with a regression test for any code change, or closed by an owner decision that rejects the finding.
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from the pre-1.0 expert panel review (main report or Beamfall/corvint-tasks addendum; confirmed by at least one verifier). Finding text: **M3. The companion bundle README falsely says `corvint-tasks --version` names the installed build.** - **Severity:** low (verifier). It is must-fix only if the companion bundle ships with rc.1. - **Core:** no, but the false text is in Corvint's own `internal/companionrelease/companionrelease.go`. - **Location:** `companionrelease.go:529` (the claim), `:136` (no ldflags for corvint-tasks), `tasks-src/internal/cli/cli.go:25` (constant version), and the gate script (which clones the sibling HEAD unpinned). - **Failure:** two different tasks builds both print `0.0.0-tcp01-unverified`. The bundle README says the build is identifiable. A bundle can ship an unreviewed tasks HEAD. - **Fix:** - Inject a build string with `-ldflags` for corvint-tasks, and print it from `--version`. `ReadBuildInfo` alone does not help, because the bundle builds with `-trimpath -buildvcs=false`. - Pin the gate to a recorded commit, or move the source in-tree (3). - Correct the README text in the same change. - **Votes:** 1/0/1, plus the chair's reading. - **Known ticket:** none.
title: panel M3: The companion bundle README falsely says corvint-tasks --version names the installed build
